Thanks for submitting this PR! When we review PRs, we follow the [Pipedream component guidelines](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/). If you're not familiar, here's a quick checklist:
- [ ] [Create components to address specific use cases whenever possible](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#component-scope)
- [ ] [Component `key`s should follow the format `app_name_slug-slugified-component-name`](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#component-key-pattern)
- [ ] Components should follow the [standard directory structure](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#folder-structure)
- [ ] [Prefer Node.js client libraries to REST APIs](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#using-apis-vs-client-libraries)
- [ ] When making API requests, [handle pagination](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#pagination) to ensure all data / events are processed
- [ ] [Use `secret` props](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#capturing-sensitive-data) to capture sensitive data
- [ ] Props and methods should be defined in [app files](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#app-files) whenever possible
- [ ] Document methods with [JS Docs](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#methods)
- [ ] [Use `optional` props](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#optional-vs-required-props) whenever possible, and [set a `default` value](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#default-values) where you can
- [ ] Use standalone actions over async options and ensure the description of the prop indicates usage of the standalone action to fetch the data for the prop
- [ ] Please address all review comments as they are added
- [ ] [Enable edits from maintainers](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/working-with-forks/allowing-changes-to-a-pull-request-branch-created-from-a-fork) to allow Pipedream maintainers to make changes to this PR
- [ ] [Create subscription webhooks sources (vs polling sources) whenever possible](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#webhook-vs-polling-sources)
- [ ] [Always emit a `summary` with events](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#emit-a-summary)
- [ ] [Use a built-in deduping strategy wherever possible](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#deduping)
- [ ] When building webhook sources, [follow these best practices](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#webhook-sources)
- [ ] When building polling sources, [follow these best practices](https://pipedream.com/docs/components/guidelines/#polling-sources)
